[[File:Prof. Eberhard Umbach 2012.JPG|thumb|Eberhard Umbach 2012]]
'''Eberhard Umbach''' (born 1948 in [[Bad Lauterberg]]) is a German [[physicist]].

== Career ==
He studied physics at the [[Technical University of Munich]] and received his doctorate in 1980 with honors. After conducting research in the United States he returned to habilitate at the Technical University of Munich in 1986.

Umbach was professor at the [[University of Stuttgart]] from 1987 to 1993 and professor at the [[University of Würzburg]] from 1993 to 2007.

From 2006<ref>Deutschen Physikalischen Gesellschaft. [http://www.pro-physik.de/details/news/1123845/Der_neue_Physik-Praesident.html "Der neue Physik-Präsident"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180420010459/http://www.pro-physik.de/details/news/1123845/Der_neue_Physik-Praesident.html |date=2018-04-20 }}. ''Pro-physik.de'', 4 May 2006. Retrieved on 11 May 2013.</ref>-2008 he was president of the [[German Physical Society]]. From May 2007 until September 2009 he was chairman of the [[Forschungszentrum Karlsruhe|Karlsruhe Research Center]]. From 1 October 2009, Eberhard Umbach served jointly with [[Horst Hippler]] as one of the two presidents of the [[Karlsruhe Institute of Technology]], until becoming sole president in 2012 after Hippler left to become president of the [[German Rectors' Conference]].<ref>Karlsruhe Institute of Technology. [http://www.kit.edu/visit/pi_2012_11722.php "Horst Hippler moves from Karlsruhe to Bonn"]. 6 September 2012. Retrieved on 11 May 2013.</ref>
